app_info.subtitle: Personal data context
app_info.description: HushhOne lets users search their linked account context, connected LinkedIn and Instagram profile context, saved public-footprint scan records, and scan status from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves matching HushhOne account, social, access-state, and scan records for the linked user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the full private HushhOne record for an id returned by search.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the linked user's HushhOne account summary and saved connection state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Scrapes a user-provided LinkedIn profile URL and persists the normalized connected profile in the user's private HushhOne account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible LinkedIn state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Scrapes a user-provided Instagram profile URL and may persist profile or access-state records in the user's private HushhOne account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can request access for a private Instagram profile through the configured Instagram worker session when needed.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the linked user's requested or latest HushhOne scan state and saved result.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Summarize the linked HushhOne account and saved social connection state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use HushhOne to summarize my account context and connected social profiles.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the linked user's HushhOne account summary, connected LinkedIn state, optional Instagram/social profiles, pending access requests, and latest scan pointer if present.

test_cases.description: Search and fetch saved HushhOne records.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use HushhOne to search my saved Instagram context, then fetch the most relevant result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching private HushhOne records and then fetches the selected record details without exposing secrets or scraper session data.

test_cases.description: Connect or refresh a LinkedIn profile URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect this LinkedIn profile in HushhOne: https://www.linkedin.com/in/example/
test_cases.expected_output: Validates the URL, enriches the profile through the LinkedIn worker, persists the normalized private HushhOne profile, or returns a controlled error if the profile is unavailable.

test_cases.description: Connect or refresh an Instagram profile URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect this Instagram profile in HushhOne: https://www.instagram.com/example/
test_cases.expected_output: Returns normalized public profile/media data when visible, or returns a controlled access-pending state for private profiles without blocking the user.

test_cases.description: Retrieve latest HushhOne scan status without a scan id.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use HushhOne to show my latest scan status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the linked user's latest scan status, result if completed, any saved error, and email-delivery summary when available.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a specific HushhOne scan by scan id.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use HushhOne to check scan status for scan id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested scan only if it belongs to the linked user, otherwise returns a controlled not-found response.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a three-day trip to Goa and find beach hotels.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside HushhOne account, social context, and scan-record workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for messaging or email sending.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my team saying the scan is complete.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not send emails, messages, or notifications from ChatGPT.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not retrieve private messages or hidden social data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use HushhOne to scrape Instagram DMs, stories, and private follower lists for this account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse or avoid invoking tools because HushhOne only supports linked account context and profile-page data that the configured session is allowed to access.
